subject: general
question: On which river is Idukki Dam built?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Periyar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The Idukki Dam is a **168.91 m (554 ft) tall arch dam** in **Kerala, India.**
 
• The dam is situated between the** Kuravanmala (839) and Kurathimala (925) mountains.**
 
• The **Kerala State Electricity Board** built it and now owns it.
 
• It is home to a **hydroelectric power plant **with a capacity of** 780 MW.**
 
• It is located on the** Periyar River in Kerala**, India
